title: Validity test for a word
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $i$ and a Boolean list $w$, define the validity test to require that the first entry of $w$, defaulting to false when absent, is true. It also requires either that $w$ passes the variable test, its body contains a false entry, and the length of its first argument is less than $n$; that it passes the one-operation test; or that it passes at least one of the addition, subtraction, or multiplication tests, its body and middle part each contain a false entry, and the lengths of both arguments are less than $i$.
caveat: The variable, operation, body, middle-part, and argument functions are not defined in the supplied material.
